steps.title: Ken: supplier invoice checklist · part 1
steps.detail: Ken wants a new founder to understand a wholesale invoice. The offer has a minimum order quantity and a delivery lead time. Which explanation helps?

choices.label: Show the quantity, unit price and arrival estimate

steps.title: Ken: supplier invoice checklist · part 2
steps.detail: Ken finds a net-term invoice was described as free credit. It actually has a due date and must be paid. What goes into the training guide?

choices.label: Explain the due date and the cash needed to pay
Hide the due date until delivery

steps.title: Ken: supplier invoice checklist · part 3
steps.detail: Ken introduces a buyer asking for a supplier invoice checklist. A missing document cannot be confirmed today. What handover can you provide?

choices.label: List checked documents and the missing item

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented supplier invoice checklist. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Ken.
